query:
SELECT EXISTS (
                SELECT 1 FROM conversations c
                JOIN user_bear ub ON ub.bear_id = c.bear_id AND ub.user_id = $2
                WHERE c.bear_id = $1 AND c.id = $3
                  AND (c.created_by_user_id = $2 OR
                       ($4 AND lower(btrim(coalesce(ub.role, ''))) = 'admin'))
            ) AS "allowed!"
